items.text: This is the third workshop round. Rounds 1 and 2 asked a total of 9 decisions — all remain unanswered. The item has no description, no scope, no tags, no archive materials, and priority 5 (lowest). The plan is entirely TBD. This round distills everything down to the single blocking question: what is this item?

items.topic: What is this backlog item about? (Blocking — nothing else can proceed without this)
items.context: Two prior rounds asked detailed questions that all depend on one fundamental unknown: what 'No Effort' means. Without even a one-sentence description, it is impossible to write a plan, identify a target scenario, set acceptance criteria, or estimate effort. This decision blocks ALL progress. If no answer is provided, the recommendation is to archive this item (see d2).

options.label: Test/placeholder item — created to exercise the backlog system

options.rationale: The name 'No Effort' might refer to backlog items that lack effort estimates — a meta-feature for the swarm-manager.

items.topic: Should this item be archived if no description is provided?
items.context: After 3 workshop rounds with no answers and no description, this item is adding noise to the backlog. Archiving removes it from active processing while preserving it for future reference. It can be un-archived if a real purpose emerges later.

options.label: Archive this item
options.rationale: Clean up the backlog. The item can be recreated with a proper description when needed.

options.label: Keep in backlog — I will answer d1 above
options.rationale: The item has a real purpose and I will provide the missing context now.
